```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))
chomage <- tribble(
  ~source, ~dataset,
  "insee", "DEMANDES-EMPLOIS-NATIONALES",
  "insee", "CHOMAGE-TRIM-NATIONAL",
  "oecd", "FAMILY") %>%
  arrange(source, dataset)
```


# Sources

```{r}
ig_d("insee", "DEMANDES-EMPLOIS-NATIONALES", "A-B-C-2005")
```


## Nombre de chômeurs

```{r}

```



## Taux de chômage

